name: plan-p3-life-first-thin-job
about: A planned campaign (V2c, prompt v5): the P3 starter preset written from the idea the Strategist recorded for "thin-job" — life at home on a job whose only fact is the weekly pay: the idea names what the facts do not hold. Every candidate should lead with the idea and state only the brief's facts.

area.label: Fixture Yard, IL
area.reason: Fixture: drivers within a day's drive of the yard.

recipe.name: Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home: the home time the brief states (every night, weekends, so many days a month), in the reader's words. If the brief states no home time, lead with the schedule or the area that keeps the driver near home. The one fact that makes it believable goes on the second line, in a few words.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck parked on a quiet {street} at {time_of_day}, a porch light on, {season}, {viewpoint}, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering

angle.idea: Lead with what knowing the pay per week means for planning life at home, without promising any time at home.
angle.proof: The job states the pay as an amount per week.

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc pays CDL drivers $1,500 per week. You know the number up front and plan the bills at home.
